component.name: Report a problem
component.summary: Tell us what went wrong, with personal details removed

description.p: Report a problem helps you write up what went wrong in Wild OS: what happened, when, and whether it happens again, with a screenshot if you like. It adds what helps fix it: the Wild OS version and the PC's model, the crash record, the log for that time and the recent updates.

Before you see any of it, your name, user name, PC name, Wi-Fi names, addresses, serial numbers, email addresses and the names of your files are replaced with placeholders. You see everything that will be in the report and can leave anything out.
Nothing is ever sent for you. There is no Wild OS server: you choose to open an issue on GitHub, save the report or copy your description.
